name: astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
one_liner: A free, ready-made set of website building blocks (buttons, menus, forms, themes) that Meta uses internally, which developers can drop into a React app instead of designing one from scratch.
buyer: A freelance web developer or small digital agency that builds client websites and apps and wants to ship a polished, on-brand UI in days instead of weeks.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it as their default starter kit for every new client project, cutting UI build time and quoting faster turnarounds.
A small agency builds a library of pre-themed client sites on top of it, re-skinning the same components for each new customer instead of rebuilding UI each time.
A SaaS founder uses the CLI's templates to launch a working dashboard MVP in a weekend instead of hiring a designer first.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a pack of premium Astryx themes and templates for specific niches (SaaS dashboards, e-commerce, portfolios)
Offer a 'website in a week' productized service for small businesses built on top of it

steal_this: Pick one niche (e.g. local service businesses) and ship 3-4 Astryx-based site templates this weekend, then sell them as a done-in-a-week website package.
